Mr Reynolds has communicated to the Society of

refts to open four holes in the bed, each xine inches

thofe that are referved are ordered to be properly

MELT of fishes. In the melt of a living cod
there are fuch numbers of thofe animalcules faid to be
found in the femen of all male animals, that in a drop

However ftrange and romantic fuch a conjedfure

§ r. Copper is found underground in three diffe¬
